metric: Linux production line coverage, excluding doctests
source_scope: tracked Rust files under workspace member src directories
line_merge: sum counts by repository-relative file and line; covered iff sum > 0

measurement.target_selection: Cargo default test targets, host target; no --all-targets
measurement.clean: cargo llvm-cov clean --locked --workspace before every shard
measurement.instrumentation: LLVM source-based -C instrument-coverage; cargo-llvm-cov default flags
